Quantum 1.1.0 was certified on 2026-07-11. It pins **nucleus v1.0.0**, **quark v1.1.5** and **orbit v1.1.0**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.0.0: orbit goes from v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.0.0 and quark stays at v1.1.5.
